Command: Do not break a bone of the Passover lamb
Summary: No bone of the Passover lamb may be broken when it is eaten.
Commandment: Do not break any bone of the Passover lamb.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. John 19:36 applies the unbroken-bone detail to Jesus, whose bones were not broken at his death. The ritual detail belongs to Israel's covenant calendar, not to Christian observance.
Purpose: Scripture's stated context: the meal is eaten in haste on the night of deliverance from Egypt, ready to depart (Exodus 12:11).
